data.name: VerificationCodeSms
data.value: MoniPay : votre code de vérification est {0}. Il expire dans {1} minutes.
data.comment: Verification SMS. {0} is the numeric code with leading zeroes preserved. {1} is its lifetime in whole minutes. Contains the product name and nothing personal.

data.name: SessionRevokedEmailSubject
data.value: Votre session MoniPay a été fermée
data.comment: Session-revoked email subject. Names the product only.

data.name: SessionRevokedEmailBody
data.value: Votre session MoniPay a été fermée le {0}.
data.comment: Session-revoked email body. {0} is the revocation time formatted for the recipient's locale. Names the time and the product only.

data.name: RefreshTokenReuseDetectedSms
data.value: MoniPay : pour votre sécurité, nous avons fermé vos sessions le {0} après la réutilisation d'un jeton de connexion.
data.comment: Refresh-token reuse SMS. {0} is the detection time formatted for the recipient's locale. Names the time and the product only.

data.name: RefreshTokenReuseDetectedEmailSubject
data.value: Alerte de sécurité MoniPay : jeton de connexion réutilisé
data.comment: Refresh-token reuse email subject. Names the product only.

data.name: RefreshTokenReuseDetectedEmailBody
data.value: Pour votre sécurité, nous avons fermé vos sessions MoniPay actives le {0} après la réutilisation d'un jeton de connexion.
data.comment: Refresh-token reuse email body. {0} is the detection time formatted for the recipient's locale. Names the time and the product only.
